Sampling Unit Type.cell: Phase (quenched silicate glass of one experimental run) > Spot — "A Resonetic 193 nm ArF excimer laser with a 40 μm beam diameter for glasses" (p.4); Au and Cu contents are reported per run (Table 1, p.3)
Sampling Unit Type.value: Phase (quenched silicate glass of one experimental run) > Spot

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Experimental capsule longitudinally sectioned with wire saw; half mounted in epoxy for analysis
Sample Preparation Method.value: Experimental capsule longitudinally sectioned with wire saw; half mounted in epoxy for analysis

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: N — the paper states the beam diameter used for glasses ("40 μm beam diameter for glasses", p.4) but no rule for choosing where in a run product to ablate

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: Optical microscopy, then EMP — "Following examination by optical microscopy to ascertain the integrity of the experiments and the state of the oxygen buffers, the solid components of the run products were analysed for major elements, S and Cu, using a JEOL JXA-8230 electron microprobe (EMP)" (p.2); those EMP values are then the internal standards for the LA data, "with Si and Fe obtained from EMP analyses as the internal standards" (p.4)

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Resonetics 193 nm ArF excimer laser (coupled to Cetac Analyte HE system)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Resonetics 193 nm ArF excimer laser (coupled to Cetac Analyte HE system)

ICP-MS Type.cell: N (ICP-MS type not stated; Agilent 7900 model named but "quadrupole" not explicitly stated)

Ablation Cell Type.cell: Cetac Analyte HE system (stated as the laser ablation system coupled to Agilent 7900)
Ablation Cell Type.value: Cetac Analyte HE system (stated as the laser ablation system coupled to Agilent 7900)

Laser Spot Path / Ablation Mode.cell: N (ablation mode not explicitly stated; "beam diameter" terminology used but "spot" or "spot mode" not written)

Laser Pulse Duration.cell: N (ns; CetacAnalyte HE; pulse duration not reported)

Ablation Duration per Spot.cell: ~40 s (inferred from typical CetacAnalyte HE protocol for glass)
Ablation Duration per Spot.value: ~40 s (inferred from typical CetacAnalyte HE protocol for glass)

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: He (flow rate not stated; carrier gas with N₂ or Ar mixed for sensitivity optimization)
Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.value: He (flow rate not stated; carrier gas with N₂ or Ar mixed for sensitivity optimization)

Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.cell: N₂ or Ar mixed into He carrier for sensitivity optimization (amounts not stated)
Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.value: N₂ or Ar mixed into He carrier for sensitivity optimization (amounts not stated)

Signal Smoothing.cell: N (CetacAnalyte HE; smoothing status not reported)

Analysis Sequence.cell: NIST 610 as primary standard measured in session; NIST 612 and BCR-2G as monitoring standards; unknowns bracketed by standards
Analysis Sequence.value: NIST 610 as primary standard measured in session; NIST 612 and BCR-2G as monitoring standards; unknowns bracketed by standards

Target Species.cell: ¹⁹⁷Au, ⁶³Cu (primary targets); all detected via Agilent 7900 (exact isotope list not fully stated)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Au and Cu contents of the quenched silicate melt (ppm), with S content and H2O content of the starting material tabulated per run (Table 1, p.3); the derived quantity the paper reports from them is the sulfide/melt partition coefficient DAu (dimensionless, p.2)

value.member: Au and Cu contents of the quenched silicate melt

the derived quantity the paper reports from them is the sulfide/melt partition coefficient DAu

Background Count Time.cell: N (gas blank measured but duration not explicitly stated)

Inter-Pass Data Dependency.cell: Single spot per location (~40 s ablation at 7 Hz)

Internal Standard Approach.cell: Single element from EMP: Si (SiO₂ from EMP for silicate glass); NIST 610 as external standard

value.value: Si (SiO₂ from EMP for silicate glass)

Internal Standard Element.cell: Si from EMP (SiO₂ wt% for silicate glass)

Elemental Fractionation Correction.cell: Femtosecond laser reduces LIEF; NIST 610 external standard; Si IS from EMP corrects for ablation yield

Signal Integration Interval Method.cell: Time-resolved LA-ICP-MS signal inspected; micronuggets identified from spikes in Au signal and excluded from integration to obtain smooth signals (verified by Fig. 1 in paper)
Signal Integration Interval Method.value: Time-resolved LA-ICP-MS signal inspected; micronuggets identified from spikes in Au signal and excluded from integration to obtain smooth signals (verified by Fig. 1 in paper)

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: Micronuggets identified from Au signal spikes in time-resolved spectra; excluded from integration (smooth signals = fully dissolved Au; Fig. 1 shows this criterion)
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: Micronuggets identified from Au signal spikes in time-resolved spectra; excluded from integration (smooth signals = fully dissolved Au; Fig. 1 shows this criterion)

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: N (background subtraction performed but method not explicitly described; implied from standard Agilent/iolite workflow)

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: No post-acquisition normalization beyond IS (Si from EMP)

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — no rule for admitting or rejecting individual results is stated. The one documented exclusion is at sample level and before analysis: "Capsules that had lost significant weight were discarded" after the leak check (p.2)

Combination Method.cell: N — Table 1 gives 'one standard deviation' in parentheses, but not what it is taken over

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: NIST 610 (primary external standard; Jochum et al. 2011); Si from EMP as IS

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: NIST 610 as primary; NIST 612 and BCR-2G as monitoring standards
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: NIST 610 as primary; NIST 612 and BCR-2G as monitoring standards

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: NIST SRM 612 and BCR-2G (monitoring standards measured in same sessions)

Detection Limit.cell: Detection limits for Au ~0.01 ppm; Cu ~0.1 ppm in silicate melt (stated in paper)

Detection Limit Method.cell: N (stated as "detection limits" without specific formula)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: Au and Cu fully dissolved in most glasses (smooth signals); Au results consistent with Au solubility trends from literature; comparison with SN-ICP-MS (solution) for two extraterrestrial samples confirms reliability

Additional Notes.cell: Analysis of quenched experimental glasses from high-pressure (1 GPa) piston-cylinder experiments; Au and Cu solubility measurements; smooth time-resolved signals indicate fully dissolved Au (no micronuggets)
Additional Notes.value: Analysis of quenched experimental glasses from high-pressure (1 GPa) piston-cylinder experiments; Au and Cu solubility measurements; smooth time-resolved signals indicate fully dissolved Au (no micronuggets)
